name: Turla - Carbon Emulation Plan
desc: The emulation plan, created by the ATT&CK ® Evaluations team, used during Day 1 of the ATT&CK evaluations Round 5. This scenario focuses on Carbon, a second-stage backdoor and framework that targets Windows and Linux infrastructures and provides data exfiltration capabilities.

acts.d: In our scenario, an email containing the spearphishing link was pre-positioned in the target user's inbox.
User clicks on the downloaded executable
An additional executable is embedded inside NTFVersion.exe via the Resource section
NTFVersion.exe writes the EPIC Injector to the user's path (indicated by the %TEMP% environment variable) as mxs_installer.exe
NTFVersion.exe modifies the registry key HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon to add a Shell key value for persistence
EPIC's guard DLL is embedded inside the resource section of mxs_installer.exe
uses CreateRemoteThread and CreateToolhelp32Snapshot API functions
mxs_installer.exe injects EPIC's Guard DLL into explorer.exe via CreateRemoteThread API
explorer.exe enumerates processes looking for internet-enabled processes via CreateToolhelp32Snapshot API
the EPIC worker DLL (the EPIC payload) is embedded in the resource section of the explorer.exe's Guard DLL
explorer.exe injects EPIC's worker DLL into msedge.exe via CreateRemoteThread API
msedge.exe enumerates all users on the local machine via NetUserEnum API
msedge.exe enumerates users' files via FindFirstFile and FindNextFile APIs
The output of the file enumeration is stored in a local log file
msedge.exe bzip2 compresses the output of its discovery commands in memory
msedge.exe base64 encodes the bzip2 compressed data in memory
msedge.exe connects to shoppingbeach.org via a POST request
msedge.exe uses a temporary AES key to encrypt the discovery output in memory, then sends the data to the C2 server
The AES key, generated by msedge.exe, is RSA encrypted
Various net group commands are executed on the local machine to find domain admins, domain computers, and domain controllers
tasklist is used to enumerate services hosted in each running process
cmd.exe reg queries ViperVPNSvc
PowerShell is used to verify which users can access the ViperVPNSvc service
the ViperVPNSvc service registry key is modified for privilege escalation
svchost.exe creates WinResSvc.exe in the System32 folder
WinResSvc.exe uses filenames mressvc.dll (Loader DLL) and MSSVCCFG.dll (Orchestrator DLL) to appear benign/legitimate
uses OpenSCManager, CreateService, RegCreateKey and RegSetValue APIs
WinResSvc.exe creates WinResSvc service using OpenSCManager and CreateService APIs
WinResSvc.exe modifies 2 registry keys via RegCreateKey and RegSetValue APIs
WinResSvc.exe uses StartService API to start WinSysSvc, which executes the loader DLL (mressvc.dll) under svchost.exe. mressvc.dll loads and executes the Orchestrator DLL (MSSVCCFG.dll).
svchost.exe injects the communications DLL (msxhlp.dll) into msedge.exe via CreateRemoteThread API
msedge.exe connects to prendre-des-vacances.fr over HTTP protocol and communicates with GET and POST requests
msedge.exe receives RSA encrypted symmetric key
msedge.exe receives CAST-128 encrypted tasking
svchost.exe uses CreateProcess API to execute cmd.exe to execute whoami
msedge.exe CAST-128 encrypts task output
msedge.exe base64 encodes the CAST-128 encrypted task output
msedge.exe downloads winsas64.bat to the Windows Temp folder
cmd.exe executes winsas64.bat
winsas64.bat sprays several weak passwords against domain admin accounts. Using Frieda's plaintext password, the C:\ drive of the domain controller is successfully mounted
svchost.exe spawns cmd.exe to delete winsas64.bat
msedge.exe creates C:\Windows\Temp\wmimetricsq.exe
svchost.exe moves C:\Windows\Temp\wmimetricsq.exe to \\bannik\C$\Windows\System32
svchost.exe remotely enumerates, modifies, and executes a scheduled task - \Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator - on BANNIK
the CARBON DLL Installer injects the communications library DLL (msxhlp.dll) into msedge.exe
msedge.exe uses peer-to-peer communication over a named pipe - dsnap - through the first CARBON DLL implant on HOBGOBLIN
svchost.exe executes cmd.exe to enumerate all groups in the domain
svchost.exe executes cmd.exe to enumerate the Active Directory Computers
msedge.exe downloads mimikatz to the Temp folder
svchost.exe executes cmd.exe to enumerate discovered groups for their members
cmd.exe moves terabox.exe to the System32 folder
cmd.exe executes terabox.exe
msedge.exe downloads PsExec to the Temp folder
msedge.exe downloads wsqmanager.exe to the Temp folder
cmd.exe moves wsqsp.exe and wsqmanager.exe to the system32 folder

acts.n: Use Alternative authentication Material: Pass the Hash
acts.d: cmd.exe executes terabox.exe to pass-the-hash with Adalwolfa's NTLM hash
the Carbon DLL Installer is copied to Adalwolfa's workstation (KHABIBULIN). PsExec executes the CARBON DLL Installer
msedge.exe connects to eunewswire.eu over HTTP protocol
cmd.exe deletes terabox.exe, wsqsp.exe, and wsqmanager.exe
msedge.exe downloads wingtsvcupdt.exe
wingtsvcupdt.exe logs keystrokes to %temp%\~DFA512.tmp
svchost.exe executes cmd.exe to delete wingtsvcupdt.exe and ~DFA512.tmp
msedge.exe downloads PENQUIN to the Temp folder as C:\Windows\Temp\tmp504e.tmp
msedge.exe downloads C:\Windows\Temp\pscp.exe
svchost.exe executes cmd.exe to execute pscp.exe to copy PENQUIN (tmp504e.tmp) to KAGAROV as /tmp/tmp514f524f using the keylogged (Adalwolfa's) credentials
msedge.exe downloads C:\Windows\Temp\plink.exe to KHABIBULIN
svchost.exe executes cmd.exe to run plink to execute PENQUIN
cmd.exe deletes tmp504e.tmp, pscp.exe, and plink.exe on KHABIBULIN
hsperfdata unpacks a binary named cron
hsperfdata copies cron to /usr/bin/ and executes cron from this folder

acts.n: Linux and Mac File and Directory Permissions Modification
acts.d: hsperfdata adds an executable flag (for executable permissions) to the created cron file
hsperfdata stops the cron service

acts.n: Create or Modify System Process: Systemd Service
acts.d: hsperfdata modifies /etc/systemd/system/cron.service for systemd to execute the created cron file
cron installs a TCP filter on the eth0 interface
cron sniffs network traffic on eth0 for a specific activation packet (the magic packet)
cron receives and triggers on a TCP packet containing a magic sequence of bytes
the TCP packet payload contains data that is base64 encoded. Once decoded, the packet contains the IP address and port to connect to the listener
cron executes a reverse shell to the listener IP and port
the JavaScript establishes a watering hole redirecting users to the adversary's malicious website
